ttresearch.page.ASPECT_ANALYZER.0:
You created a device that tells you what aspects an item has.

Place an item you have already scanned into it, and all its aspects will appear under the slot.
ttresearch.page.SHARE_TOME.0:
If one day you happen to want to share your knowledge with the rest of the world, this is the item for you.

Right click a blank tome to write all your research into it, then hand it to someone else: by right clicking it, they'll get all the research you've discovered so far.
